mapper.sql: item_id, apply_year, seq_no, audit_area, audit_item, item_detail, audit_period, regulation, use_yn, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT apply_year FROM checklist_item ORDER BY apply_year DESC
SELECT FROM checklist_item WHERE apply_year = #{year} AND seq_no = #{seqNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist_item WHERE apply_year = #{year}
